description:
I used to think that adventurous people were just…born that way. And that I was too old to try any of it 😢

Turns out, age is just a number. And those adventurous people are  usually just people willing to look stupid long enough to become good at something new. 🤘🏻 

Snowboarding at 30.
Ice hockey at 41.
Skateboarding, skiing, wakeboarding at 42.

I wanted my kids to see a mom who goes for it.
Not a mom who slowly got smaller, safer, quieter, and “too old.”

Your life does not have to become more boring as you age.

You are ALLOWED to keep becoming someone new. 

Want my process to help you shift into an entirely new version of yourself (and to figure out what you want that to even look like?? Comment SHIFT and I’ll send you my simple 90-day process (it really works) ❤️
transcript: Run, run fast for your mother, run fast for your father Run for your children, run for your sisters and brothers Leave all your loving, your loving behind You can't carry it with you if you want to survive The dark days are over, the dark days are done Can you hear the houses of God I call?
